text:
Pearls are typically found in oysters.

To enrich the artistic concept of the exhibition, the playlist's hip-hop tracks can be adapted to mirror the organic formation of pearls. Just as a pearl is created through a slow, layered process within an oyster, the hip-hop beats and lyrical flows can be structured to build intensity gradually, reflecting the relentless pace of urban life. The gritty atmosphere of the city can be echoed through raw, unpolished lyrical content, while the energetic beats provide a rhythmic pulse that mimics the heartbeat of the metropolis, creating a harmonious blend of natural elegance and urban grit.
